findings.finding: Readable generic arc integral implication omitted a<=b.

findings.finding: The generic finite-sum step needs continuous g_j and f=g_j on each open arc, in addition to a nondecreasing grid.
findings.counterexample: One interval[0,1], f identically1 and g0 identically0 gives1!=0 if comparison agreement is omitted.
